issue.title: test_lsp_store_rechecks_after_waiting_for_identity_lock flakes when fake cargo finishes before the second store contends
issue.description:
## Flake report

- **Test:** `tests/test_sase_core_wheel_cache_tool.py::test_lsp_store_rechecks_after_waiting_for_identity_lock`
- **Repro:** `sase tool run check` in the opened SASE checkout (failure is load-dependent; isolated reruns of the node pass)

The test starts a first `store` subprocess with `FAKE_CARGO_DELAY=0.3`, waits until a cargo-count marker exists, then runs a second `store` and asserts `"Waiting for the shared build lock"` appears in the second process's stderr. Under parallel scoped pytest load the first fake cargo can finish before the second contends, so the waiter never sees the lock message (`AssertionError: 'Waiting for the shared build lock' in ''`). Isolated serial reruns of the same node on the same tree pass.

Root cause: the 0.3s fake-cargo delay plus a 5s marker poll is not enough contention when the suite is already loaded. Tighten the wait (hold the first process in cargo until the second is observed, or assert lock wait with a longer/deterministic hold) rather than suppressing the node.

task_type_fields.evidence: Failed once under parallel scoped load of SASE governed check `5d1634e22bc172fe358db97b9279961f` (fmt/lint/mypy/pyscripts/docs/validate/committed-plans passed; test-scoped 1442 passed, this node failed). Isolated `sase tool run test` of the same node on the same tree passed 3/3: `d79366e7627ad5290e34d797cb5c6a7a`, `f02021819c78b654a26d3739e330ddeb`, `6d94f3e4d28d96bbaf830bde9189b048`. Serial pass rate 3/3; parallel fail rate 1/1 observed in that check. B5 nested-validation edits do not touch this test or the wheel-cache lock path.

issue.creation_reason: SASE governed check 5d1634e22bc172fe358db97b9279961f failed this node under parallel scoped load; three isolated reruns on the same tree passed, so the B5 closeout cannot treat it as a B5 regression.
